svg.title: Nghệ An rice yield against normal, per season, past years 1995-2024
svg.text: Nghệ An rice yield against normal, per season, past years 1995-2024
Past years, not a forecast. Bar: the NSO rice yield of the year against its past-only normal, in %. n/a: no value.
Open dot: the M1 out-of-sample estimate of a test year, from a model trained on earlier years only. Line: its 80% range.

g.text: Model estimates not shown for this season; the reason is on the method page.
This season is not modelled; no model estimates.

svg.text: Source: artifacts/risk_table.json, Nghệ An rows: NSO yields (R-D01), past-only normal (E-010), M1 estimates and 80% ranges (E-012).
